validation.rootTestsNote: Isolated host-root run: DSH_CONTROLS_HOST_ROOT plus the checksum-bound accepted tarball, so no environment-gated host integration case was skipped. A plain node --test without that host seam reports 768 cases with 286 environment-gated skips.
validation.featureEvidence: History documents are re-parsed on every capture, and re-parsing re-validated and re-froze every unchanged row payload. Rows validated by an earlier parse are now reused by identity, measured against the largest local store (338 rows, 561 KB): 9.32 ms per re-parse before, 0.94 ms after, with the process total idle CPU at about one third of a core and this plugin at roughly 8 percent of main-thread samples.
validation.privacy: Only six closed assets published; no local raw logs, profile snapshots or session evidence
